data.research_question: What are the exact model files (YAML config + .th weights) needed for htdemucs_ft to work offline with python-audio-separator (nomadkaraoke)?

findings.title: YAML Config File
findings.detail: The config file is named exactly: htdemucs_ft.yaml
findings.notes: This tiny YAML defines the bag-of-models ensemble pointing to 4 fine-tuned .th files. audio-separator expects this file by that exact name in the model_file_dir.

findings.title: Model Weight Files — htdemucs_ft is a BAG OF 4 MODELS
findings.detail: Unlike htdemucs_6s (single .th file), htdemucs_ft consists of FOUR separate .th files, one fine-tuned per stem. All four must be present for offline operation.

findings.title: Download Source — dl.fbaipublicfiles.com
findings.detail: audio-separator's demucs_separator uses the upstream facebookresearch/demucs pretrained.py download logic. The base URL is: https://dl.fbaipublicfiles.com/demucs/hybrid_transformer/
findings.notes: The facebookresearch/demucs repo was archived read-only on 2025-01-01, but the fbaipublicfiles URLs remain live. HuggingFace mirrors (Derur/UVR-models, Politrees/UVR_resources) are reliable fallbacks.

findings.title: Comparison with htdemucs_6s
findings.detail: htdemucs_6s uses ONE file: 5c90dfd2-34c22ccb.th (~84MB). htdemucs_ft uses FOUR files totaling ~337MB. This is the key architectural difference — ft is an ensemble of 4 separate fine-tuned models.
findings.why_4x_slower: audio-separator runs all 4 models sequentially and picks per-source output from the model fine-tuned for that source.

findings.title: SAMPLAR Portable — models/ directory layout for offline use
findings.detail: Based on SAMPLAR_portable.json (TORCH_HOME=models, XDG_CACHE_HOME=models), demucs models should be pre-cached at:
findings.notes: audio-separator passes --model_file_dir to demucs which sets the local cache root. All 5 files (1 yaml + 4 .th) must be in the same flat directory.

data.recommended_approach: Pre-download all 5 files (htdemucs_ft.yaml + 4x .th weights) into SAMPLAR_Portable/models/ before shipping the portable build. Total ~337MB. Use dl.fbaipublicfiles.com URLs as primary, Derur/UVR-models HuggingFace as fallback.
implementation_roadmap: 1. Download htdemucs_ft.yaml (149 bytes) from Politrees/UVR_resources on HuggingFace
3. Place all 5 files flat in SAMPLAR_Portable/models/
4. Pass --model_file_dir pointing to models/ when invoking audio-separator
5. Verify offline operation by disconnecting network and running a test separation
potential_pitfalls: htdemucs_ft needs ALL 4 .th files — missing any one causes runtime failure. Unlike htdemucs_6s (1 file), you cannot partially cache htdemucs_ft.
The YAML file is mandatory — without htdemucs_ft.yaml audio-separator cannot resolve the bag-of-models ensemble definition.
Total size is 337MB, not ~84MB like the single-model variants. Budget accordingly in the portable build.
dl.fbaipublicfiles.com is Meta's CDN and has been reliable, but the demucs repo is archived (read-only since 2025-01-01). URLs still resolve but no future updates.
File naming is hash-based (e.g. f7e0c4bc-ba3fe64a.th) — do not rename the files or demucs will fail checksum validation.
audio-separator by default caches to /tmp/audio-separator-models/ — for portable use you must explicitly pass --model_file_dir.

community: Derur/UVR-models htdemucs_ft folder (all 4 .th files confirmed, 337MB total): https://huggingface.co/Derur/UVR-models/tree/main/htdemucs_ft
demucs.cpp GGML sizes reference (81MB per model in GGML = ~84MB in .th): https://github.com/sevagh/demucs.cpp
